description: Unit test classes for Orleans' Newtonsoft.Json serialization support, including deep copy and round-trip serialization tests, as well as native JSON type serialization.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for Newtonsoft.Json serialization and deep copy support in Orleans.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for deep copying of Newtonsoft.Json types within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer builder to add Newtonsoft.Json serializer support based on a type predicate.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a sample instance of MyNewtonsoftJsonClass for testing.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonDeepCopyTyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of a strongly typed MyNewtonsoftJsonClass instance.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonDeepCopyUntyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of a MyNewtonsoftJsonClass instance via untyped copier.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip through the codec.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonRoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip through an untyped serializer.

methods.name: CanSerializeNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Verifies that native JSON types (JArray, JObject) can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanCopyNativeJsonTypes
methods.description: Verifies that native JSON types (JArray, JObject) can be deep copied correctly.
